{{Hatnote|This article is about the Steam Workshop author. For the card, see [[Moment Of Triumph]].}}'''Triumph''' is a Steam Workshop author who published a Star Wars CCG table for playing [[Star Wars CCG]] in [[Tabletop Simulator]].<ref name="triumph" />

| 29 March 2015 &ndash; 18 February 2023 || Published Star Wars CCG, a [[Tabletop Simulator]] Workshop table for [[Star Wars CCG]]<ref name="triumph" />
|}
